notes: Not a real problem: the four groups are separate in the booklet, so I kept them unconnected. The booklet builds three independent models, each with its own thumbnail: the umbrella table (pp3-6), the oven with cake (pp7-10) and the sink (pp11-12). The finished-set picture on p13 shows them standing apart with nothing joining them. The stool (b12, b13) is a separate sub-assembly built at the end of the table pages (p6) and placed beside the table, not clipped to it. Joining them would add connections the manual never makes.
Groups: table b1-b11; stool b12-b13; oven with cake b14-b28 (door b19 joined by hinge, dish b28 joined around the grill brick); sink b29-b41.
Minifigure (head, hair, torso, legs; page 2) is not in the 41-piece parts list so it is not recorded.
Black 1x1 round plates: 1 on the oven box, 1 on the sink's right stud beside the tap, and 2 on the sink's round bricks (assumed under the pink plates) to make the list's count of 4.
The cake (grill brick, tan plate, 2 pink plates, pink dish) sits across the top of the lime stack and the black plate on the box, so the black plate acts as a spacer to level the box top.
Door b19 hinges to the box and is recorded with rests_on [] since the hinge is its attachment; the tan plate carrying the pink plates and tile sits on the door tray.
Umbrella dish b11 rests on the bar top; the bar b4 is held in the pin hole, not clutching studs.
